operations.description: This notification is sent when an account has been closed.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the closure of an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account closed [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account close error field notification response type

operations.description: This notification is sent when an account has been created.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the creation of an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account created [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account create error field notification payout response schedule type

operations.description: This notification is sent when an account holder has been created.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the creation of an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account holder created [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address business check create details error field holder individual kyc notification payout processing response result state status type verification vias

operations.description: This notification is sent when a payout request to an account holder has been processed and the payout has been scheduled.
operations.summary: Triggered upon a payout to an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account holder payout [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account amount bank content detail error field holder message notification operation payout status type

operations.description: This notification is sent when the status of an account holder has been changed.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the status change of an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account holder status change [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account change content error field holder notification payout processing state status type

operations.description: This notification is sent when an account holder has been updated.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the update of an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account holder updated [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address business check details error field holder individual kyc notification payout processing response result state status type update verification vias

operations.description: This notification is sent when KYC Verification results are made available.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the receipt of KYC Verification results.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account holder verification [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account check content data holder kyc notification status summary verification

operations.description: This notification is sent when an account has been updated.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the update of an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account updated [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account error field notification payout response schedule type update

operations.description: This notification is sent when a benefactor/beneficiary relationship between accounts has been set up.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the setup of a beneficiary.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] beneficiary setup [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] beneficiary content error field notification setup type

operations.description: This notification is sent when funds have been transferred from the Marketplace's liable account to an overdrawn account in order to compensate for the overdraft.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the compensation of negative account balances.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] compensate negative balance [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] balance compensate content negative notification record

operations.description: This notification is sent when a payment to an account has failed. In these cases, the funds which were meant for the account are redirected to the Marketplace's liable account.
operations.summary: Triggered upon an account payment failure.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] payment failure [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] content error failure field message notification payment type

operations.description: This notification is sent when a report has been made available.
operations.summary: Triggered when a report is made available.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] report available [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] available content notification report

operations.description: This notification is sent when a 'Refund Transfers Not Paid Out' call has been processed and the associated refunds have been scheduled.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the scheduling of refunds requested by a 'Refund Transfers Not Paid Out' call.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] scheduled refunds [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account amount bank content detail error field notification refund refunds result scheduled transaction type

operations.description: This notification is sent when the funds from an account have been transferred to another account.
operations.summary: Triggered upon the transfer of funds between accounts.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] transfer funds [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] amount content error field funds message notification operation status transfer type
